title: Universal skill surfaces use canonical names
summary: Shipped Zonoid instructions should present canonical skills as primary: orchestrator-loop for loop/dispatch work, self-learn with explicit modes for judge/edge/benchmark/KB/QA work, and zonoid-orchestrator for client repo workflow. Legacy names such as orch-loop, parallel-orchestrate, self-learn-* and zonoid-orchestrator-opencode remain shipped compatibility aliases, not installer/runtime/doc primary surfaces.
